description: Every update waits on the dependency dashboard until someone ticks it.
constraints: the lockfile is written with the same npm major as CI's. The runner's newest npm (12) refuses remote tarballs by default, and @tailwindcss/oxide's wasm fallback needs one.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes come from Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml), which also reads the lockfile; a second PR from Renovate would duplicate it.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Offered once a month, so indirect packages do not drift far behind.
schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: npm packages can be unpublished within 72 hours and hijacked releases surface in the first days, so the dashboard offers the newest version that is at least two weeks old.
Overrides pin vulnerable transitive packages by hand; Renovate cannot update them in the lockfile without clashing with the override.
Patch and minor updates are offered together once a week as one PR.
The lint plugin is young; each release may add findings, so it is offered weekly in its own PR and the CI lint job shows the effect.
